 Dense Fog Advisory is in effect Unsettled weather pattern this week with several chances for rain 
 Monday Afternoon Forecast By Brandon Rector Published : Oct. 26, 2026 at 7:42 AM CDT | Updated : 19 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LINCOLN, Neb. (KOLN) - Showers, and maybe some thunderstorms too, will be possible from time to time throughout this week. Severe weather is not in the forecast at this time. Temperatures look to be above average for most of the area as well.
 Today will be mostly cloudy to cloudy with a wide range of temperatures. Cold front that moved through much of the state should lift back to the north as a warm front in at least Southeastern Nebraska. High temperatures look to be in the upper 30s in Northwestern Nebraska to the upper 70s in the southeastern part of the state. There is a 20 to 40% chance of isolated to scattered showers throughout the day. Part of Northwestern Nebraska and the panhandle may see a rain, sleet and snow mix. Very little to no snow accumulation is expected.
 Forecast High Temperatures Monday (KOLN) Tuesday looks to be mostly cloudy with a 20% chance of rain. High temperatures will be in the low 50s to upper 60s.
 Forecast High Temperatures Tuesday (KOLN) Wednesday should be partly to mostly cloudy with a 30% chance of showers and thunderstorms in mainly Eastern Nebraska late in the afternoon and evening. High temperatures will be in the low 60s to upper 70s.
 Forecast High Temperatures Wednesday (KOLN) More rain is possible at times Thursday through Sunday. The best chances right now look to be Friday and Saturday. Stay tuned to the forecast this week if you have plans to go out trick-or-treating for Halloween or are going to the Nebraska football game Saturday night. As of now, there is a 30% chance of rain Saturday evening.
